title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One British Grand Prix?
background: The British Grand Prix is held at Silverstone as part of the Formula One World Championship.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The race classification published by Formula One or the FIA, corroborated by contemporaneous race reporting. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the British Grand Prix scheduled for July 5, 2026. Sprint results do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's name.
